title: PackingStar Game-Theoretic RL Breaks High-Dimensional Kissing Number Records (Dims 25–31 & 13D)
whyItMatters: Formulated high-dimensional sphere kissing as a two-player matrix-completion game—surpassing all human-known lower-bound records across dimensions 25–31, breaking a 1971 13D rational record, and uncovering 6,000+ new structures.
summary: Introduced in November 2025 (and expanded through v5 in September 2026) by Chengdong Ma, Théo Tao Zhaowei, and collaborators (arXiv:2511.13391), PackingStar cast the centuries-old Kissing Number Problem—how many non-overlapping unit spheres can simultaneously touch a central unit sphere in n dimensions—as a cooperative two-player reinforcement learning game over pairwise-cosine Gram matrices, where one player adds entries and a second player corrects suboptimal entries. PackingStar reproduced known records and surpassed all human-known kissing-number lower bounds from dimensions 25 through 31, broke the 54-year-old 1971 rational-configuration record in dimension 13 (raising Kr(13) from 1,130 to 1,146 spheres with exact rational Gram verification), set new generalized multi-sphere kissing records, and revealed over 6,000 novel geometric structures—several non-antipodal and linked to finite simple groups.
technicalHighlights: Surpassed human-known kissing-number lower bounds across dimensions 25–31 (beating 2011/2016 meta-constructions) and set new records for generalized double- and triple-sphere kissing numbers.
Broke the 1971 rational-structure record in 13 dimensions (1,130 → 1,146 spheres) with exact rational pairwise cosines verifiable without floating-point approximation.

Discovered over 6,000 new geometric configurations—including non-antipodal arrangements and algebraic links to finite simple groups—inspiring follow-up human-and-AI improvements in 2026 (arXiv:2609.21591).
caveats: Establishes exact verifiable constructive lower bounds rather than proving upper-bound optimality, and the manuscript remains an arXiv preprint under active mathematical study.

scoreRationale.foundational: Pushed back long-standing high-dimensional kissing-number records across 7 consecutive dimensions (25–31) plus a 54-year-old 13D rational record.
scoreRationale.ripple: Directly inspired multiple 2026 follow-up discrete-geometry papers refining the PackingStar constructions and extending RL to extremal geometry.
scoreRationale.verification: Explicit Gram-matrix constructions (including exact rational matrices in 13D) are directly checkable and independently reproduced by subsequent 2026 preprints.
scoreRationale.velocity: Explored high-dimensional spherical-code configuration spaces far beyond human geometric intuition via cooperative RL.
